stem: Short-term memory (STM) is best described as which of the following?

options.label: A
options.misconception: Biochem — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: B
options.text: An allosteric pocket on an enzyme
options.misconception: Biochem — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: C
options.text: Permanent archival store of childhood episodes
options.explanation: STM is temporary; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: D
options.text: A brief store that works on sensory input
options.misconception: None; STM temporarily processes sensory input.
options.explanation: OpenStax: STM is a temporary storage system processing incoming sensory memory.

options.label: E
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

context: Learning objective: STM is temporary processing storage.
imageCaption: Encoding/STM; hippocampus declarative memory; amygdala fear memories; mnemonics and rehearsal.
